authority.scope: DERIVED executable adapter connecting the CONFIRMED/MIXED Mur'rek case seed to the generic FTL event replay runtime. It may admit real observations and produce provenance-safe downstream packets; it may not fabricate observations or select a transit family.

measurementAdmission.negativeEvidenceRule: Absence is admissible only when capability, coverage, resolution, bandwidth/dynamic range, survivability, and damage establish detectability. NOT_OBSERVED, below-resolution, saturated, inaccessible, and destroyed-channel states are not zero measurements.

activeTestAdmission.unknownFamilySafeEnvelopeRule: A_unknown must be a subset of the intersection of safe active-test envelopes for every admissible Mur'rek hypothesis; an empty or unproven intersection rejects active testing.
requiredGates: protected recovery reserve excluded from test budget
hazard observability maintained on independent channels
activeTestAdmission.lossOfObservabilityRule: Loss of a hazard-observation channel requires abort unless an independently validated guard channel survives.

discriminationExport.promotionRule: At least two provenance-independent operator-level discriminator groups surviving damage, detectability, covariance, and contradiction review, unless a higher-authority named source directly identifies the mechanism.

mathematics.uncertainty: U = {Sigma_random, Sigma_cal, Sigma_clock, Sigma_reg, Sigma_damage, Sigma_model, Sigma_contam}

mathematics.abortability: T_abort >= t_detect + t_validate + t_command + t_actuate + t_decay + t_margin

api.timestampPolicy: Caller must supply recordedAt/observedAt. The runtime refuses to invent investigation timestamps.

provenance.sourceGraph: The different lightspeed methods -> named Mur'rek archive -> Mur'rek engineering/discrimination authorities -> case seed -> Mur'rek case runtime adapter -> generic immutable event replay -> evidence instance -> installation archaeology -> transit forensics -> Mur'rek discrimination.
provenance.replayRule: Events append; later interpretations supersede by reference and never rewrite historical observations. Source assertions remain source constraints rather than synthetic measurement packets.
